bestBets.overview: BLACK PEPPERMINT put in an eye-catcher splitting two nice types 2nd up. Has been beaten by horses with less weight with this sort of load in the past 3rd up form is excellent. ARISTONOUS has drawn better than when game after working on pace at Sandown. VERONA RUPEES if leaders are favoured. SPYLARK has won here over the trip. BLACKLIST may improve for new stable. DARTBOARD and NICOFFHOME ready for 2000m. STORMSARRIVED well held 1st up but has never relished soft going; capable of 2nd up improvement if track dries out.

raceTips.comment: Black Peppermint is extremely well graded in this class coming off two solid runs at metro grade this campaign. He has bumped into Perfect Ten in both starts, surging from last first-up over 1600m before a huge run again from back in the field when second at Caulfield on August 8. He is eligible for a $30,000 VOBIS bonus, so it seems a set play to target this race by Patrick Payne. If he runs as well as he did last start, he might just be too good for this field.

bestBets.overview: The consistent THOUGHTFUL rises 2kg for a win at this level over this trip at this track last start; has been sound carrying such weights in the past. DUSTY'S DEEL was a first up third behind him and has a decent swing around in the weights (though trickier draw). SOLAR MIST has not been having the best of luck of late; has yet another wide gate (his fourth in a row) but his last runs have contained merit. HYDROGEN POWER is suited back up to the mile (four of his five wins have come at this trip). PARTY AT ARTIE's also looks ready for 1600m whilst MR GEORGE may show more back in class.

raceTips.comment: The booking of Linda Meech might be a sign that Surfy Pete can be a big improver third-up. He ran well first-up at Mildura before being basically retired out of the race last start. Forgive that run and he is right in the game here. Thoughtful won at this track last start and maps to get a dream run from the inside draw. Hydrogen Power may roll further forward now second-up at 1600m and could be tough to run down if he lands in the lead.
